_comment: The single source of truth for every dated, numbered claim Leg makes in public. scripts/check-claims.mjs asserts that each surface listed here states exactly these values, and --strict additionally reports which pinned CLIs have moved (the local binary, or npm where none is installed) and fails once verifiedOn is more than maxAgeDays old. Re-verify on a real machine, then edit this file and every surface in the same commit.

agy.label: agy
agy.note: Antigravity CLI is a closed Go binary with no npm package, so drift is only visible from a machine that has it installed. On 1.5.17 (2026-11-25) every flag Leg passes is still in agy --help, a headless run through the runner parsed Leg's argv and returned its JSON envelope, and the shipped binary still contains RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, 'it resets in' and 'out of quota'. This machine's agy is signed out, so the success path and a live quota wall were not re-observed on 1.5.17 (fixtures/live/agy/signed-out-probe.json).

grok.label: grok
grok.note: Grok Build ships as a downloaded binary, not an npm package. Still 1.0.34 on 2026-11-25: the flags in fixtures/help/grok.txt were re-captured from grok --help, and no prompt was spent because the account balance is exhausted. The 402 wall in fixtures/live/grok/ was observed on 2026-09-17; the success path of a grok leg is still unprobed for want of balance on the account.
